== Summary ==
Slip “•Cloud City: Beldon’s Corridor” cut unchanged from page 9 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF file created 10 August 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (71, 1305, 758, 1854)).
